categories.title: Fountain
categories.info: Fountains are points of interest that supply ancient water, which is used to water the Oasis Buds across the Glass Desert. To activate them, you must supply three nearby slime statues with the correct plort.

categories.title: Gordo Slime
categories.info: Gordo Slimes are very large slimes that contain a variety of items. Gordos require 50 of a specific food to burst, but their favorite types of food counts for 2!

categories.title: Oasis Bud
categories.info: Oasis Buds are small flowers scattered around the Glass Desert. Water them with ancient water to see them grow!

categories.title: Slime Gate
categories.info: Slime Gates are large doors with slime face in the middle. To open these, you'll need to use one of the slime keys that you can get from Gordo Slimes!

categories.title: Slime Statue
categories.info: Slime Statues are statues that are in the shape of a specific slime. Place the correct plort that matches that slime into the statue for something special to happen!

categories.title: Vault
categories.info: Vaults are old structures filled with valuables. These will only appear after completing the game and getting a specific piece of mail!

categories.title: Gilded Ginger
categories.info: Gilded Ginger is a very rare vegetable. Every day at 5am in game, only two Gilded Ginger spawn on the map.

categories.title: Hobson's Note
categories.info: Hobson's Note are notes left behind by the previous owner of the ranch, Hobson Twillgers. Read them all to understand the full story!

categories.title: Map Data Node
categories.info: Map Data Nodes are small data spots that will remove the fog of the area from the map!

categories.title: Treasure Pod
categories.info: Treasure Pods are pods scattered around the map filled with a wide variety of items. To unlock them, a certain upgrade is needed: Treasure Cracker MKI to open Treasure Pod MK1, Treasure Cracker MKII to open Treasure Pod MKII, and Treasure Cracker MKIII to open Treasure Pod MKIII.
